svg.title: Framework for Estimating Hyporheic Function
svg.desc: Conceptual overview of Exchange Frequency, Exchange Duration and Exchange Extent, followed by the four HYPE function families and the headline metrics each one reports: Nutrient Cycling, Pollutant Attenuation, Habitat Creation and Temperature Regulation.
svg.text: Three hydraulic dimensions describe exchange opportunity; process assumptions screen potential function.
What combination of water delivery and subsurface contact occurs?
How much of the river corridor participates in exchange?
Extent is the connected spatial footprint.

text.tspan: Equivalent active depth and active volume summarize
the participating domain; they do not measure function.

g.text: Pathway calculations + process inputs + specific assumptions
